# Lightbox { #anylumino.astryx.Lightbox }

```python
Lightbox(media, *, open=False, index=0, zoom=False, auto_play=False, **props)
```

Display one image or video, or a gallery, in an Astryx lightbox.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                                   | Description                                                                                                                                                                   | Default    |
|-----------|--------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| media     | Mapping\[str, Any\] \| Iterable\[Mapping\[str, Any\]\] | One media mapping or a gallery of mappings. Every item requires ``src`` and accessible ``alt`` text; ``type`` may be ``"image"`` or ``"video"``, and ``caption`` is optional. | _required_ |
| open      | bool                                                   | Controlled open state synchronized through ``is_open``.                                                                                                                       | `False`    |
| index     | int                                                    | Controlled gallery index synchronized through ``value``.                                                                                                                      | `0`        |
| zoom      | bool                                                   | Whether images support double-click zoom and drag-to-pan.                                                                                                                     | `False`    |
| auto_play | bool                                                   | Whether video starts playing when the lightbox opens.                                                                                                                         | `False`    |
| **props   | Any                                                    | Additional JSON-safe Lightbox props forwarded to Astryx.                                                                                                                      | `{}`       |

## Astryx Props {.doc-section .doc-section-astryx-props}

``media``, ``isOpen``, ``index``, ``hasZoom``, and ``hasAutoPlay`` are
adapted by the named arguments above. ``**props`` keeps the wrapper
forward-compatible with additional JSON-safe Astryx props.

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

Video media uses Astryx's native player with browser playback controls.

See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Lightbox>.
